'''2007 Utah State Championship Trevor Ewald LS Quick Draw (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Trevor Ewald]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quick Draw (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon)|OVS9-17-Quick_Draw-remaster.webp|label=Quick Draw (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Treva Ewald
* '''Deck name:''' Light
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
